title: Carbon allotropes can have very different electronic behaviour
original_forecast: Compare the installed solid-state electrical descriptors for graphite and diamond with a metal and a polymer reference. Shared carbon composition is not evidence of the same bonding topology or electronic structure.
original_limitations: Aqueous conductivity and solid resistivity are different quantities. Use the reported quantity and units; an unsupported solid measurement must not be interpreted as zero conductivity.
lock_qualification: Producer-reported manifest hash; artifact omits raw Cargo.lock bytes.

assessment.hold_reason: Diamond and polyethylene have no installed reviewed solid resistivity; missing readings cannot complete original graphite/diamond/metal/polymer electrical comparison.
assessment.model_scope: Shared carbon inventory and distinct density are established, but do not supply the missing diamond electrical descriptor. Particle glyphs encode elemental inventory, not bonding topology or electronic structure. Unsupported measurements are not zero conductivity.
